bnf-fr13020-f297.summary: Des Noyers tells Boulliau he has seen his little note and is sure that, but for the Queen, nobody would wait for the death of the Prince of Spain to break off the marriage, and that la Mancini must be very bold to try what Boulliau reports of her. The five ciphered phrases are the sense of the note; the rest is plain text.
bnf-fr13020-f297.en: I have seen your little note, and I certainly believe that, but for the Queen, they would not wait for the death of the Prince of Spain to break off the marriage; and la Mancini must be very bold to undertake what you tell me of her.

system: Two-digit numerical nomenclator (00-99): letters and syllables; a mark above a group (ring, circumflex, cross, bar, accent) makes it a code word
